plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer in RFQ Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ whose bidding has ended and is in evaluation time.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case setup.
Ensure counter offers are visible on RFQ rounds.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Assert that Send Bulk Counter Offer is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select the enabled action to open its counter-offer window without submitting it.
Verify that the bulk counter-offer window opened.
Cancel the window so no counter offer is confirmed.
Assert that the counter-offer window closed after cancellation.
